ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Approximately 60% low-intensity (black) pixels concentrated in the central peduncle-to-notch region and outer margins, with 40% high-intensity (white) pixels localized in the interior lateral lobes.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Large contiguous high-intensity white regions occupy the inner-medial areas of both lobes. Left lobe contains a dense cluster of low-intensity circular blobs at the distal tip. Right lobe features a complex lattice of low-intensity lines and white-ringed circular motifs.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Deep, narrow V-shaped cleft with a measured pixel-depth approximately 15% of the total vertical height of the visible fluke; interior angle approximately 40 degrees.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency micro-serrations (sawtooth pattern) visible along the entire trailing boundary. Prominent larger indentations (notches) are detected at regular intervals, particularly approaching the distal tips.

localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Faint diagonal and horizontal dark pixel streaks (rake marks) are visible cutting through the white pigmentation on the mid-right lobe.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Brown/tan textured protrusions consistent with barnacle colonization (Coronula diadema) are visible on the extreme outer edges of both distal tips.
other_distinctive_markers: Water spray/droplet artifacts are captured in the foreground across the lower fluke boundary; a partial avian silhouette (bird) is visible in the lower-left foreground water surface.
